description: Matteo Giacomo Prina of Accademia Europea provides hourly run-of-river and reservoir hydropower profiles for five PLANtoACT pilot regions. National ENTSO-E generation for 2020–2024 is downscaled using each region’s share of installed capacity in the JRC Hydropower Database. A correction preserves five-year average equivalent full-load hours in a representative 8,760-hour profile. Coverage includes Lombardia, Alba, Oberland, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes and the Porto Metropolitan Area. Porto has no significant reservoir capacity, so only run-of-river generation is supplied there. The six freely accessible ZIP archives contain CSV and text profiles, XLSX plant summaries, regional boundaries and supporting metadata under CC BY 4.0. The source identifies energy planning and capacity-expansion simulations as intended uses. A limitation is that these normalised, downscaled profiles do not directly measure regional plant generation. The related PLANtoACT building-stock record describes another project input; separate technologies and regional files remain components of this single dataset.
